rationale: Record Pulp-owned runtime staging and release-safety work for the development-only Vellum D15 GPU-audio provider. The family is crossed by exactly one selector: test/cmake/test_installed_sdk_runtime_staging.cmake, which verifies that an installed Pulp SDK stages the provider only for a final Mach-O image that loads its exact LC_ID and leaves an unrelated consumer clean. The remaining changes implement or test Pulp's private GPU-audio provider, SDK runtime delivery, attribution, and fail-closed shipping guards. No design importer, generated output, generic renderer contract, Vellum source, accepted expansion boundary, or implementation authority changes.
